milestone.title: Native Rust geometric intelligence — conversation, memory, reasoning and coding
milestone.description:
Build useful local geometric intelligence in Rust: preparation, learning, artifacts and inference. Prime/ordered-n-let addresses, fixed zeta phases, R4/S3/H4 state, exact Z[phi]/orientation, typed paired-H4/icosian geometry and UOR identity remain primary. Offline Rust training may use matrix multiplication; serving uses learned bounded geometric routing/state and integer/table operators, with no hidden dense transformer or response provider.

Immediate owner-adopted sequence (2026-09-05): #1137 role-aware shared source selection/commit -> #1138 learned exact relations beyond the raw window -> #1139 selective geometric access at complete cost -> #1140 learned typed operator composition for conversation and Rust reasoning. #973 is the model parent; #820 is the programme tracker. Only the earliest unmet step is immediate work. An accepted behavioral handoff, not mere issue closure, unlocks the next step.

Canonical plan and responsibility consolidation: https://github.com/UOR-Foundation/uor-r4/blob/main/docs/integration/project-track.md
Actual implementation/artifacts/results: https://github.com/UOR-Foundation/uor-r4/blob/main/docs/integration/current-state.md

After the four accepted handoffs: broader #954 correctness, #955 reasoning, #962 conversation/service, #1088 coding/workspace, #963 optimization, #964 guarantees/publication and #965 integrated qualification/release. Both alpha capability groups remain unqualified. Historical positive, negative and unavailable results retain their exact scope.

One task/agent; budget-friendly complete cycles and cumulative accounting. Necessary storage increases are preauthorized and recorded; no deletion or paid compute. Protected PR delivery remains required. Planning changes do not establish model capability or geometric advantage.

issue.body:
Programme root: #820  
Role: retained GI-0 foundation feeding #961 and #952  
Downstream contract: #961 consumes the canonical artifacts; #952 remains blocked on #958 terminal delivery and reconciliation.  
Authoritative design: `docs/adr/0003-fixed-zeta-prime-route-attention.md`

## Evidence boundary

#951 remains terminal `REDESIGN_REPRESENTATION`:

- real versus coordinate-permuted held-out advantage: `4.4416%`, below the frozen `5%` gate;
- teacher/student advantages: `4.4031%` / `4.5190%`;
- bounded support and persistent memory were causally load-bearing;
- operator-alignment and sampled-token terms remained effectively flat;
- report digest: `blake3:98cae8e27808b7a5bd4e330bfd389a13f4720643da8315224e0510b89ab72469`.

This evidence is not lowered, rescored, or recast as total geometric failure. It establishes that the learned four-coordinate Q/K mixer selected support but did not transport adequate semantic value.

The later learned semantic-value diagnostic was stopped without a terminal report and is `NOT_RUN`: both possible outcomes led to the same factorable-route redesign, so continuing it had no decision value. Its code remains historical comparator material, not the #958 target.

## Objective

Implement ADR-0003 at the bounded layer-29 seam:

- immutable zeta-grid basis;
- registered prime route atoms;
- square-free semiprime transition experts and ordered n-let context;
- R⁴/S³ spin, Hopf S² observation, retained fiber phase, and local torsion transport;
- exact `Z[φ]` radial-shell updates;
- canonical κ-bound spin manifest; and
- bounded direct indexes:

```text
I1[last_route]
I2[previous_route, last_route]
IS[ordered_sentence_route]
```

Candidate selection uses only those rows plus declared divisor-overlap and adjacent-spin fallbacks. No learned dense Q/K projection and no scan of every prefix or corpus position is permitted.

Source weights may be used later as an offline teacher and transitional behavioral control. They do not define or populate serving geometry.

## Acceptance order

### 1. Source-free algebra

- [ ] Typed continuous-null/discrete-empty-product bridge is explicit and κ-bound.
- [ ] Prime, square-free semiprime, n-let overlap, and GCD handoff tests pass.
- [ ] Ordered route identity distinguishes reversal and repeated factors.
- [ ] Local zeta phase delta matches the declared wrapped log-ratio reference.
- [ ] S³ normalization, Hopf projection, retained fiber phase, and local torsion update pass.
- [ ] `Z[φ]` multiply/inverse steps are exact integer add/subtract operations.

### 2. Canonical manifest and worker canary

- [ ] Manifest binds zeta basis, prime registry, experts/n-lets, route order, spin/torsion, bridge mode, radial shell, payload CIDs, tokenizer/corpus/compiler provenance, and rebuild witness.
- [ ] Canonical decode/re-encode round trip passes.
- [ ] Changing basis, route order, bridge mode, spin/torsion, payload, or provenance changes κ.
- [ ] Worker count does not change semantic bytes or κ.
- [ ] The same partitionable tiny corpus compiles with one and four workers to byte-identical output.
- [ ] Telemetry shows all four workers process non-empty partitions and reports elapsed time and throughput.
- [ ] Four workers must improve measured wall time on the canary. Otherwise stop and profile before any larger run.

### 3. Causal direct attention

- [ ] Runtime reads a bounded number of `I1`, `I2`, `IS`, divisor, and adjacent-spin rows.
- [ ] A trace reports rows read, candidates examined, tie-breaks, and selected support.
- [ ] No future route enters a query or control.
- [ ] Perturbing last-one, last-two, sentence route, phase delta, and torsion changes declared candidate support or ordering on matched fixtures.
- [ ] Equal-budget permuted and count-only controls use the same payload and candidate ceilings.
- [ ] No learned Q/K call, dense full-prefix matrix, or all-corpus scan is reachable.

### 4. Bounded product probe

- [ ] Five no-Ollama, 32-token real outputs are UTF-8-decodable, distinct, and free of period-1 through period-4 cycles.
- [ ] At least four of five pass the frozen grammatical and prompt-responsive review.
- [ ] Real route indexes outperform or causally differ from equal-budget permuted and count-only controls.
- [ ] Readability inherited from unreplaced source layers is not counted as geometric-attention success.
- [ ] No reasoning claim is made; this issue establishes representation and one-step/sentence-route attention only.

### 5. One bounded teacher comparison

Only after stages 1–4 pass may one source-teacher comparison run. It must reuse frozen traces where possible, report progress/ETA, checkpoint resumable work, and have distinct positive and negative actions. No corpus expansion, parameter sweep, all-layer work, or fallback decoder is allowed.

## No-long-run gate

- No hours-long or corpus-scale job may launch before stages 1–4 pass.
- Before any run expected to exceed 15 minutes, post a run contract containing the metric, reachability ceiling, cheap instrument, exit rule, distinct outcome actions, wall-clock budget, checkpoint interval, and resource impact.
- The one-worker/four-worker canary is a hard prerequisite, not an informational benchmark.
- Every longer command must expose completed/remaining units, throughput, and ETA.
- Eight hours is a hard kill ceiling, not an estimate. A run reaching it stops and records `NOT_RUN` or its last completed bounded result; it must never be allowed to continue because it may be nearly finished.
- A missing checkpoint, unknown denominator, absent ETA, failed worker canary, or identical positive/negative action stops the run before launch.

## Terminal outcomes

- `PROMOTE_TO_G2`: all applicable algebra, manifest, worker, causal-attention, product, and bounded-teacher gates pass. Only this outcome makes #952 eligible.
- `ITERATE_G1R`: direct geometric attention is causally established, but exactly one localized product or integration defect remains with a bounded decision-bearing successor. #952 stays blocked.
- `RETAIN_STORAGE_RECALL_ONLY`: factorable addressing, manifest, or recall works, but geometric attention is not established. Preserve it without transformerless, attention, or reasoning claims; #952 stays blocked.
- `NOT_RUN`: prerequisites, fixtures, observability, time budget, or worker gate are unavailable/incomplete. No inference from partial progress; #952 stays blocked.

## Definition of done

- [ ] ADR-0003 implementation and source-free tests land.
- [ ] Canonical one/four-worker artifacts and lookup traces are retained.
- [ ] Product and, if authorized, teacher reports carry exact κ/CID bindings.
- [ ] Documentation states the observed capability and limitations.
- [ ] #951 negative evidence remains unchanged.
- [ ] #958 closes with exactly one terminal outcome above and an explicit #952 blocker decision.

## Pre-outcome gate audit complete

The live issue body, tracker #949, and programme root #820 now carry the amended decision hierarchy **before any #958 diagnostic or fitting outcome**.

The amendment preserves #951's exact `REDESIGN_REPRESENTATION` verdict and its historical 5% gate. It does not lower or retroactively clear that gate. It separates:

1. causal bounded routing and load-bearing memory;
2. representation-independent and selected-design reachability;
3. operator and token trainability in their own terms; and
4. matched-control product behavior.

The old combined-loss threshold could nearly pass from support cross-entropy alone, while the old binary negative branch could abandon a working routing/memory mechanism without an oracle falsifier. The new outcomes are `PROMOTE_TO_G2`, `ITERATE_G1R`, and `ABANDON_LAYERWISE_REPLACEMENT`, with exact distinct actions in the issue body.

No new fit has been run. The next action is the frozen #951 diagnostic instrument; its results and the single-fit run contract will be posted here before any real-source fitting.

comments.body:
Draft partial-delivery PR #960 is open: https://github.com/UOR-Foundation/uor-r4/pull/960

The freshly rebuilt optimized release canary passed in 7.420 s. Across 32 compiles, one and four workers emitted the exact pinned canonical CID and manifest kappa; every four-worker compile used all four workers with complete sentence/transition accounting. Median compile time moved from 655.911 ms to 437.610 ms, or 1.498x. The runner now proves Cargo release + opt-level 3, begins its watchdog/hard-wall clock at command entry, streams bounded child evidence without a scratch-path race, and revalidates the complete frozen report before publication.

SpiralCore v63 is bounded as an optional source-free operator adapter: six prime carriers map to the fifteen semiprime experts / fifteen Cl(0,6) bivector slots. E8 remains a separate 8D action plane, Bell is the MF 2-of-6 codec, and RFC 3849 IPv6 is presentation only. Embedded page fixtures are NOT_RUN and must be reproduced in Rust before use.

This does not establish the complete manifest, geometric attention, chat, inference, reasoning, or teacher parity. No long run is authorized. #952 remains blocked while #958 continues with complete manifest/rebuild witnesses, the bounded operator reproduction, causal intervention, and no-Ollama product gates.

## Complete implementation pushed; programme continues beyond exact recall

The complete #958 implementation is now on draft PR #960 at commits
`404bc1f3` and `794991d1`.

The bounded #958 verdict is `RETAIN_STORAGE_RECALL_ONLY`: the source-free
prime/semiprime/n-let substrate, schema-2 manifest, exact reconstruction,
four-worker compiler path, optional v63 operator reproduction, and bounded
causal selection mechanics are retained. The no-Ollama product probe and
teacher comparison were not run because the lexical route compiler, payload
decoder, recursive global-route state, and source-free generation loop do not
exist yet. Treating exact-corpus continuation as chat would have been false.

This is not abandonment of geometric intelligence. The decisive negative
fixture identifies the next mechanism: exact sentence-row misses currently
collapse different global histories when their local suffix matches. The
programme reset now makes hierarchical route state explicit—current and next
candidate, previous, last-two, sentence, paragraph, conversation, and global
accumulated routes—over the fixed zeta grid, R4/S3 compute state, Hopf S2/R3
observation, torsion/phase transport, exact `Z[phi]` radial shells, typed
zero/identity bridge, and paired-H4 E8 implementation bridge.

Development QA is now dormant by default in the branch. No further local test,
teacher, corpus, or long-running job is being launched. The live merge-queue
ruleset can only be disabled by a repository administrator; issue #940 will
carry that exact external blocker.

#958 will close only after its code lands. Its evidence remains the foundation
for the new route-native attention, inference, correctness, and reasoning
programme rather than a substitute for that programme.

## GI-0 reparent note — 2026-08-26

#958 has moved natively from legacy tracker #949 to authoritative programme root #820. Its fixed-zeta prime-route, manifest, operator, and bounded-attention work is retained as the active **GI-0 foundation** feeding S0 #961 and A1 #952.

This hierarchy change does not revise #951's negative gate, erase #958's existing run contract, or promote storage/recall evidence into coherent inference. The original body and artifact evidence remain intact.
